thread_text:
1. One search away

Security researchers just found a trove of Artex AI hacking tools exposed online. Anyone with a browser could stumble on them.

2. Not script kiddie stuff

These tools automate real intrusion attempts—port scanning, credential stuffing, exploit delivery. They run themselves.

3. Your endpoints are indexed

Scanners constantly crawl for exposed services. If yours is open, it may already be in a database.

4. The AI advantage

Artex adapts attack paths in real time, learning from failed attempts. That makes defense harder than ever.

5. Check your domain now

Search your own domain on Shodan or Censys today. If you find an exposed Artex endpoint, report it immediately.
